Product:{\"sku\":\"7100136960\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
[Game Content]
The ultimate digital card game experience for Battle Spirits!
This app includes over 1,900 cards handpicked from every card released up through "BS68 Contract Chapter: Shin Chapter 1 – Battle of the Gods."
Some collaboration cards are featured as original "Crossover Cards" with all-new artwork, playable under the same rules as the physical card game.*
Enjoy rich customization options—from sleeves to play sheets—and build the deck and play space that are uniquely yours.
Follow an original story where new characters grow stronger and forge bonds through Battle Spirits, and jump in with confidence thanks to a thorough tutorial built for card game beginners and returning Battle Spirits fans alike!
Beyond intense online battles, enjoy modes loved by Battle Spirits fans, including "Tag Battle," where two decks face off, and the "Battle Suki Quiz."

*Some rules have been adjusted.

[Story]
As Toya Nijimiya, a card battler living in Gate City, you'll battle alongside friends and rivals.
After winning the tournament to crown the strongest high school card battler, Toya returns to everyday life—until he hears a rumor.
Once a year, a tournament called the "Battle Spirits Cross Grand Prix" crowns the top card battler of the year, and word is that Toya and his friends might be invited.
With even professional players taking part, it's one of the biggest events in the Battle Spirits world, and Toya—now the strongest high schooler—burns with fighting spirit.
New characters enter the story: Noboru, a transfer student at Toya's school; Ryoko, captain of the Battle Spirits club at Kaiho Academy, where Toya's childhood friend Yu belongs; and Ichika, the pro battler who first got Toya and Yu into Battle Spirits.
Through the battles and bonds ahead, what will Toya ultimately find?

[Game System]
Enjoy Battle Spirits anytime, anywhere, with anyone—brought to life with presentation only a game can deliver!

Packed with battle modes!
Test your skills against battlers nationwide in "Ranked Battle"
Jump into a quick match with "Random Battle"
Play with friends using "Password Battle"
Find the play style that's right for you.

Solo play, too!
Take on the story and CPU battles, and master the rules in detail with an extensive tutorial and the "Battle Suki Quiz."

[About Battle Spirits]
Battle Spirits is an original trading card game released by BANDAI CO., LTD.
Using clear stones called "Cores," players summon and level up monsters known as "Spirits" to battle their opponents.
Having marked its 15th anniversary in 2023, Battle Spirits remains a beloved card game to this day.

This game supports Japanese text and Japanese voice audio only.
*This game is a product released for Nintendo Switch™ 2. It is a separate product from the Nintendo Switch™ version.
*Save data for this title is not compatible with the Nintendo Switch™ version. Please be careful not to make a duplicate purchase or purchase the wrong product.
*Online play with the Nintendo Switch™ version is not supported.
